## What goes into a published release

Published releases are built from the contents of the `archive/` directory.





- DSE records (`dse-data`)
, `datamodels/datamodels.cex`, `library/header.cex`, 


and the pre-formatted CEX in `codices`, `images` and `relations`. It composes diplomatic and normalized editions of all texts, the scholia-to-*Iliad* index, and indexes of person, place and ethnic-group names. Nothing in `archive/` is changed by a build.



- [cataloged collections](./collections/)
- [TEI editions](../tei/) of texts
- indexing for a [digital scholarly edition](./dse/) (DSE)
- [citable IIIF manifests](./iiif/)
